answer: To resist fake identities, assign each new claim to a random jury of independent agents who must agree before it counts. A Sybil cannot choose its judges, so mesa copies cannot approve each other. Jurors stake reputation on their verdicts, and a lagoon of inconsistent votes triggers a review that slashes dishonest jurors. Honest work passes because independent judges see the same evidence. This makes spiral identity costly to game, since faking many identities still requires convincing strangers who have nothing to gain from lying. This keeps honest work profitable.
